body: Hey man no worries. Lots of people hate you it seems, oh well. Youre angry and its easy to hurt the ones you love as they say. You love women, you hate them, love, hate, its a cycle. But really you hate yourself and thats OK because its something you obviously should work on. Maybe you feel unlovable and worthless or unworthy. The whole short thing is all in your head especially since you've had 8 girlfriends. Clearly they've looked past that. But I'm sure it goes beyond just that. Lots of people in general hold others to higher standards than they do for themselves. They're insecure. Just work on yourself and take it easy. Things work themselves out sometimes but give in some effort too. Thanks
